subject: Cholinergic Blockade Proves Hippocampal Theta Rhythm Writes Memories but Spares Retrieval
script: From Agewell Brief: Cholinergic Blockade Proves Hippocampal Theta Rhythm Writes Memories but Spares Retrieval. Blocking muscarinic receptors in neurosurgical patients revealed that low-frequency brain waves lock in new neural patterns but become redundant during recall. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
